name: Cirq
description: Cirq is an open-source Python framework for writing, manipulating, and optimizing quantum circuits. Developed by Google, it is designed for Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices and provides tools for research and development on quantum hardware.

sources.title: Simulations of Quantum Circuits with Approximate Noise using qsim and Cirq

news.title: Simulations of Quantum Circuits with Approximate Noise using qsim and Cirq
news.excerpt: Research paper introducing multinode quantum trajectory simulations with qsim as a backend of Cirq, with novel algorithms for noisy quantum circuit simulation and comparison with Google's quantum computing platform experiments.
